question: top Avocado Oil brands companies South Africa
markdown:
South Africa's top avocado oil producers and brands include
pioneer processor Westfalia Fruit, regional specialists like Da Gama Avocado Oils and Del Avo
, and bulk suppliers detailed on the
⁠South Africa Avocado Oil Market Size Report
. Growth trends and industry overviews are also outlined by

Leading Producers and Brands
Westfalia Fruit:
The first and largest commercial producer of avocado oil in South Africa, offering plain, lemon, garlic, and butter-flavored variants.
Da Gama Avocado Oils:
Operates a processing facility in Mpumalanga producing high-grade extra virgin and refined culinary oils.
Del Avo:
Based in Tzaneen (Limpopo), specializing in cold-pressed culinary avocado oils and associated natural body care lines.
Mokhado:
A joint venture by local farming families in Limpopo producing cold-pressed extra virgin options.
Denova Oil (Pty) Ltd:
Known for supplying natural plant-based cooking oils, including specialized local avocado oils.
